criteria.requirement: Implement tabulate.formatters.tabulate_with_formatters(data,headers=(),*,formatters=(),**options). Reuse pinned normalization, then apply callable(value,data_row_index,column_index) or None per column before rendering through tabulate. Do not call formatters on separator rows or absent ragged cells; row indices count business rows only. Preserve original data, propagate callback errors, validate callbacks and excess columns, support keys/firstrow headers and original options including disable_numparse. Do not add a global formatter registry or alter tabulate signature.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
